# XYZ Tiles

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Configure a raster XYZ tile source from a URL template (\{z\}/\{x\}/\{y\}).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "xyz-tiles", "name": "xyz-tiles", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "sourceConfig"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:tileSize`, or read elsewhere as `ch('xyz-tiles/tileSize')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
This operator has no input ports.
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `url` | `string` | `"https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"` |  |
| `subdomains` | `string` | `"abc"` |  |
| `tileSize` | `float` | `256` |  |
| `minZoom` | `float` | `0` |  |
| `maxZoom` | `float` | `19` |  |
| `attribution` | `string` | `""` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
|------|------|
| `sourceConfig` | `value` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
